details: All 1000 validation S1 IDs in the artifact are valid train_source1 entity IDs; validation_predictions.tsv and validation_predictions_step9.tsv share identical S1 ID sets; split is deterministic via GroupShuffleSplit(random_state=42)

Artifact covers all 1000 validation S1 entities (S1 population COMPLETE) but covers only 0.37% of their ground-truth target matches (ground-truth population INCOMPLETE); classification is BOUNDED_VALIDATION_ARTIFACT

The candidate generation stage is identical for both validation_predictions.tsv and validation_predictions_step9.tsv (same 39967 pairs, same 1000 S1 IDs); both artifacts derive from the same blocking run; no candidate-generation code was modified between steps

The previous model evaluation (evaluate_persisted_validation_predictions) used exactly the same 1000 validation S1 IDs and the same 39967 candidate pairs; however it reconstructed ground truth solely from the 13 artifact-positive labels, making the reported F0.5 an artifact-bounded metric that cannot be compared to a full-population recall figure
